players.product: large-megawatt diesel and gas backup generator sets (with in-house Enercon enclosures/packaging) for hyperscale and colocation data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Generac's 10-K says it relies on outside manufacturers for certain products and components, including large engines used in data center backup applications, and procures certain diesel engines, cooling packages and alternators for its larger C&I products from various suppliers; given the data center opportunity it expects to increase manufacturing, test cell and packaging capacity further to serve data center customers globally. Remaining performance obligations (excluding extended warranty, and excluding contracts with an original term of one year or less) were $378,782 (in thousands) as of December 31, 2025, 100% expected to be recognized within the next two years; capital expenditures were $169.9 million in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $378,782 thousand at Dec 31, 2025 (100% within two years); capex $169.9 million in 2025
